original: う〜ん、う〜ん
traducao: Hmm, hmmm...

original: う〜〜〜〜〜むむむむ……
traducao: Hrmmmmmmm...

original: ……どうしたの？\n随分、悩んでいるみたいだけど……
traducao: ...Is something wrong?\nYou seem quite troubled...

original: 悩むよ〜！\n悩むに決まってるじゃん！
traducao: Of course I am~!\nHow could I not be?!

original: だって、だってぇ……
traducao: I mean, I mean...

original: うん……話、聞くよ？
traducao: Yeah... I'm listening, okay?

original: だってぇ……
traducao: Well, you see...

original: 最初はルーク様狙いだったけど\nちょっとわがまま過ぎるのがアレだしぃ
traducao: At first I had my eye on Master Luke,\nbut he's just a bit too spoiled...

original: ウッドロウ様もゼロス様も\nナイスイケメン∀　だけど\nどっちも競争率高そうだしぃ
traducao: Both Lord Woodrow and Master Zelos\nare super hunks! But competition\nfor them looks fierce...

original: アスベル様も領主の息子ってとこで\n捨てがたいんだけど\n何か真面目一直線過ぎ？　っていうか〜
traducao: Lord Asbel is a lord's son too,\nwhich is hard to pass up, but\nhe's way too strait-laced~

original: となるとぉ、やっぱり……
traducao: Which means, after all...

original: スパーダ様が、アニスちゃんの王子様\nなのかなぁって∀\nえへへ∀　∀えへへ∀∀
traducao: Lord Sparda might just be\nAnise-chan's prince! Ehehe!\nEhehe~!

original: そ、そう……なんだ。\n大変だね……
traducao: I-I... see.\nSounds rough...

original: きゃわ〜〜〜ん、このギルドってば\n何気により取り見取りじゃん！
traducao: Eeeeeep! This guild is actually\nfull of top-tier choices!

original: アニスちゃん困っちゃう〜〜∀∀
traducao: Anise-chan is so spoiled for choice~~!

original: この船の乗員も、随分増えたものね
traducao: The crew on this ship has grown so much.

original: そうですね。\n大勢の方がいらして、\nとても賑やかになったと思います
traducao: Indeed.\nWith so many people aboard,\nit has become quite lively.

original: 老若男女ってヤツだね∀
traducao: People of all ages and walks of life!

original: この調子で、\nお金持ちがも〜〜っと増えてくれれば\n最高なんだけどね〜∀
traducao: At this rate, if waaaay more\nrich people joined the ship,\nit'd be the absolute best~!

original: っていうかさ、人だけじゃなくて、\n色んな動物っぽいのも増えてない？
traducao: Though hasn't the ship gained\nlots of animal-like folks too?

original: う……、そうですね
traducao: Er... you are quite right.

original: それってつまり、ロックスさんや\nモフモフ族の皆さんの事ですよね？
traducao: You mean Rocks and the members\nof the Fluffy Tribe, correct?

original: 何か、生き物大集合！　\nって感じ〜？
traducao: It's like a grand gathering\nof all kinds of critters~?

original: これをウリにして、お客さん集めてぇ、\nギルドを観光名所に出来ないかなー∀\nなんて……∀
traducao: Couldn't we use that to draw tourists\nand turn the guild into a hotspot?\nJust wondering~!

original: そうねえ。\n例えばだけど、ここら辺で無機物な奴とか\n出て来たら面白いんだけどね〜
traducao: True enough.\nIt'd be fun if some inanimate\nthing popped up around here~

original: 無機物……ですか？
traducao: An inanimate... object?

original: それってつまりぃ〜、\n機械とか物が動いたり\n喋ったりするってこと？
traducao: You mean like machines or objects\nwalking around and talking\non their own?

original: そうそう
traducao: Exactly.

original: ほら、タンスが歩き回って\n喋ったりしたら面白くない？
traducao: Like, wouldn't a walking,\ntalkwardrobe be hilarious?

original: いや、気持ち悪いだけだわ……
traducao: Actually, that's just creepy...

original: ですね……
traducao: Indeed it is...

original: 中にタンス預金があれば……
traducao: If it has a secret cash stash inside...

original: あ〜、暇だなぁ〜。\nな〜んか、楽しい事ないかなぁ〜
traducao: Aah, I'm so boooored~\nIsn't there anything fun to do~?

original: そうだネ〜
traducao: Sure is~!

original: 暇とは何です、暇とは。\nお二人とも、緊張感が足りませんよ
traducao: What do you mean, bored?!\nYou both lack any sense of urgency!

original: ぶーぶー。\n少しぐらい、気晴らししたって\nいいじゃん
traducao: Boo, hiss!\nWhat's wrong with having a little\nfun to pass the time?!

original: そうだ！\nみんなでさ、あれやって遊ぼうよ！
traducao: I know!\nLet's all play that game together!

original: 騎士団と、泥棒に分かれて\n遊ぶ……何だっけ、ほら……
traducao: You split into knights and thieves...\nWhat was it called again? You know...

original: ああ、「どろきし」のこと？
traducao: Oh, you mean 'Thieves & Knights'?

original: そうそう、それだヨ！
traducao: Yeah, yeah, that's it!

original: 運動になるし、暇も潰せて\nいい事づくめ……
traducao: It's good exercise, kills time,\nand has lots of perks...

original: 待って下さい。\n今、何ておっしゃいました？
traducao: Please hold on.\nWhat did you just say?

original: え〜？　\n何って、何？
traducao: Eh~?\nWhat do you mean, what?

original: 先程の、遊びの名前の事ですよ！
traducao: I mean the name of the game just now!

original: あ〜、「どろきし」のこと？
traducao: Ah, 'Thieves & Knights'?

original: そう、それです
traducao: Yes, that!

original: ずばり言わせていただきますが\n「きしどろ」の間違いじゃないですか？
traducao: Allow me to be blunt: aren't you\nmistaken? It's 'Knights & Thieves'!

original: まっさかぁ〜。\nだって、泥棒が主役の遊びなんだから\n「どろきし」の方が正しいでしょ！
traducao: No waaay~!\nThe thieves are the stars of the game,\nso 'Thieves & Knights' is right!

original: いいえ。\n騎士団が偉いんだから、\n「きしどろ」に決まってます！
traducao: Incorrect!\nThe knights hold all authority,\nso it must be 'Knights & Thieves'!

original: ちょ、ちょっと二人とも……\n少し落ち着こうよ
traducao: H-Hold on, you two...\nLet's calm down a bit.

original: そんなのどっちでもいいじゃない。\nネ？
traducao: Either way is totally fine, right?\nHuh?

original: どこがいいってのよ！
traducao: It is NOT fine at all!

original: ちっとも良くありません！
traducao: It is not fine in the least!

original: も〜〜〜。\nこれじゃ、全然遊べないヨ……
traducao: Geez~~~\nWe can't play at all like this...

original: じゃあ、誰か他の方にも聞いてみましょう
traducao: Then let us ask someone else!

original: 「どろきし」と「きしどろ」、\nどちらの呼び方で通っているか、\n文句なしの一発勝負です！
traducao: 'Thieves & Knights' or\n'Knights & Thieves'--we settle\nwhich is standard once and for all!

original: いいよ。\nやったろーじゃん！
traducao: Fine by me.\nLet's do this!

original: （後で吠え面かくなよ、チビッ子！）
traducao: (Don't come crying later, runt!)

original: も〜、二人とも強情だなぁ……
traducao: Sheesh, you're both so stubborn...

original: 何だお前ら、そんなつまんねえ事で\n喧嘩してんのかぁ？
traducao: What're you arguing over such\na stupid thing for, huh?

original: 俺のとこじゃ、\n「きしどろ」も「どろきし」も\nどっちも使わねえな
traducao: Where I'm from, we don't use\n'Knights & Thieves' or\n'Thieves & Knights' at all.

original: うっそ！？
traducao: No way?!

original: 第三勢力の介入ですか！？
traducao: A third party intervention?!

original: じゃあ、ヒスイのとこは\n何て名前で呼んでたの？
traducao: Then what did you call it\nwhere you grew up, Hisui?

original: 「ちゅんさんとんとん」だ
traducao: It was called 'Chun-san Ton-ton'!

original: ちゅんさ……？
traducao: Chun-sa...?

original: え、何それ……。\n初めて聞いたんですけど……
traducao: What on earth is that...?\nI've never heard of that before...

original: 言葉のどこにも、騎士と泥棒が\n入ってないじゃないですか……
traducao: Neither 'knight' nor 'thief'\nis anywhere in that name...

original: はっ、まだまだ甘いな！
traducao: Hah, you've still got a lot to learn!

original: いいか？\n「駐在さん」と「山賊」で\n「ちゅんさん」なんだよッ！！
traducao: Listen up!\n'Resident cop' and 'mountain bandit'\nmake 'Chun-san'!!

original: じゃあ、とんとんって……？
traducao: Then what about the 'Ton-ton'...?

original: そりゃ、ただの語感だ。\n言った時に、気持ちいい感じがするだろ？
traducao: That's just rhythm. It rolls right\noff the tongue, doesn't it?

original: さて、今日のご飯は\n何にしよっかな〜☆
traducao: Now then, what should I eat\nfor dinner today~?

original: たっぷり卵のオムレツの\nホワイトソースがけはいかがですか？
traducao: How about an extra-egg omelet\ndrizzled with rich white sauce?

original: バターでライスとベーコンを\nよぅく炒めて、ソースは生クリームを\nふんだんに使うのがオススメです
traducao: I recommend frying the rice\nand bacon in lots of butter,\nwith plenty of heavy cream.

original: うげっ。\n何かカロリー高そう……。\n他にいい案とかないの？
traducao: Blech.\nThat sounds insanely high-calorie...\nGot any other suggestions?

original: そうですねぇ
traducao: Let me think...

original: グラタン、カルボナーラ、\nピザ、シチュー……\nあっ、ステーキなんかもいいですね
traducao: Gratin, carbonara,\npizza, stew... Ah, steak\nwould be marvelous as well.

original: って、それ全部高カロリーじゃん！！
traducao: Hey, all of those are high-calorie!!

original: そんなの食べたら、\n女子はみるみる太っちゃうっての！
traducao: If a girl ate that kind of food,\nshe'd gain weight in no time flat!

original: だからいいんじゃないですか……
traducao: That is precisely what makes it good...

original: え？
traducao: Huh?

original: いえ、何でもありません
traducao: No, it is nothing at all.

original: 余計な口を挟んでしまって\n申し訳ありませんでした。\n僕も、そろそろ仕事に戻りますね
traducao: I apologize for intruding.\nI shall return to my chores\nshortly, then.

original: 何か今、ものすごく\nダークなものを見た様な……
traducao: I feel like I just caught a glimpse\nof something profoundly dark...

original: ウッドロウさまぁ∀
traducao: Lord Woodrow~!

original: 初めまして。\n私、アニス・タトリンって言います。\nよろしくお願いします∀
traducao: It's an honor to meet you.\nMy name is Anise Tatlin.\nIt's a pleasure~!

original: ああ、よろしく。\n私は……
traducao: Yes, nice to meet you.\nI am...

original: ウッドロウ様はぁ……、\nもう、将来を誓い合った恋人とか\nいらっしゃるんですかぁ？
traducao: Lord Woodrow~... Do you happen\nto have a lover you've pledged\nyour future to already~?

original: いや、そういった相手は\n特にいないよ
traducao: No, I do not have anyone\nlike that in particular.

original: きゃわ〜〜ん∀\nこれってばチャンス？\nもしくは、運命なのかも？？
traducao: Eeeeeep!\nCould this be my chance?!\nOr perhaps... destiny?!

original: ウッドロウ様ぁ∀\nもし良かったら、今度……
traducao: Lord Woodrow~!\nIf you'd like, next time...

original: それ以上！\nいやらしい目でウッドロウさまを\n見ないで下さいっ！
traducao: Stop right there!\nDo not look at Lord Woodrow\nwith such scandalous eyes!

original: げっ。\n何か面倒なのが出て来た
traducao: Gah.\nA total pest just showed up.

original: ウッドロウさま。\nいけません、こんな女の甘言に乗っては！
traducao: Lord Woodrow! You must not fall\nfor this woman's sweet-talk!

original: 大丈夫だよ、チェルシー。\n何か誤解をしている様だが……
traducao: It is all right, Chelsea.\nIt seems there is a misunderstanding...

original: ぶーぶー。　そうだよぉ。\nアニスちゃん、ただウッドロウさまと\nお話してただけなのに、ひどいよぅ……
traducao: Yeah, totally! Anise-chan was\njust talking with Lord Woodrow.\nYou're being so mean...!

original: 泣き落としでウッドロウさまの\n気を引こうとしたって駄目です。\n……その手には乗りませんから
traducao: Fake tears will not win\nLord Woodrow over! I will not\nfall for your tricks!

original: （ちっ。勘付かれたか）
traducao: (Tch. Did she see right through me?)

original: これだけは言っておきますけど\nウッドロウさまのお嫁さんになるのは\nこの私ですから！
traducao: Let me make one thing clear:\nthe one who will become\nLord Woodrow's bride is ME!

original: その話なんだけどぉ……。\nそれって、正式に婚約とかしてるの？\nウッドロウ様の公認とか？
traducao: About that, though...\nAre you two formally engaged?\nDid Lord Woodrow endorse that?

original: そ……そういうわけじゃ\nないですけど……
traducao: Th-That's not exactly how\nit is, but...

original: なんだ。\nただの妄想か
traducao: What.\nJust pure delusion, then.

original: ？\n今、何か言いました？
traducao: ?\nDid you just say something?

original: 別に、何も〜？☆
traducao: Nope, nothing at all~!

original: とにかく、ウッドロウさまは\n渡しませんから！
traducao: Regardless, I won't ever\nhand Lord Woodrow over to you!

original: 渡すとか渡さないとか、\nそもそもあんたのじゃ\nないでしょっての
traducao: 'Hand him over'?\nHe was never yours to begin\nwith, you know.

original: しかし、ウッドロウ様には\n面倒なのが付きまとってるわけか……
traducao: Still, Lord Woodrow has quite\na nuisance clinging to him...

original: これって、他の相手も見繕って\nおいた方がいいのかも……？
traducao: Maybe I oughta look into other\nsuitable candidates just in case...?

original: ゼロス様ぁ∀\n良かったら今度、私と\nどこか遊びに行きませんかぁ？
traducao: Master Zelos~!\nWould you like to hang out\nwith me sometime~?

traducao: Ah, sorry, Anise-chan!\nThe great me has a suuuper\npacked schedule right now.

original: また今度誘うから\nその時にヨロシク∀
traducao: I'll invite you next time,\nso stay tuned, babe!

original: えっ、ゼロス様……
traducao: Huh? Master Zelos...

original: ティアちゃ〜ん∀\nこれから俺さまとデートしない？
traducao: Tear-chaaaan!\nWanna go on a date with me?

original: お断りするわ
traducao: I refuse.

original: あ〜んもう、ティアちゃんってば\n冷たい∀
traducao: Aww, come on, Tear-chan,\nyou're so cold!

traducao: Tch... A ladies' man just like the\nrumors say. Reeling him in might\ntake way too much time...

traducao: Better think of another angle...

original: お金持ちは、他にも\nい〜〜っぱいいるもんね！
traducao: There are still tons and tons of\nother rich guys around, after all!
